title: Mobility-Gap Robustness and Středa-Hall Separation in Disordered Axion Pumping
summary: We show that the noncommutative second Chern number of a $(3+1)$D disordered axion pump remains quantized beyond global spectral gap closure at $W_g \approx 14.5$. Large-scale computation of the second Chern number and finite-size scaling demonstrate convergence of $\mathrm{Ch}_2$ toward $-1$ well into the mobility-gap regime ($W \lesssim 16.5$), while the Středa-Hall response $\partial_φ\mathrm{Ch}_{0,3}$ departs rapidly after global spectral gap closure, serving as an internal control that distinguishes bulk mobility-gap protection from finite-size artifacts.
